competences.description: Attacks all enemies to grant Irresistible for 2 turns.

Attacks all enemies 3 times. The first hit steals 1 beneficial effect with a 50% chance, the second hit increases their chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns with a 50% chance, and the third hit leaves a Branding effect for 2 turns with a 50% chance. Gains 1 stack of Chaos Force whenever attacking an enemy granted with Irresistible.

Attacks all enemies. Gains 5 stacks of Chaos Force if the boss is granted with a beneficial effect. When attacking enemies granted with Irresistible, Chaos Force increases by the number of those enemies.

Decreases the HP of all enemies by 1% per stack of Chaos Force, and then attacks all enemies with an attack that ignores all damage reduction effects. The damage dealt increases by 1% per stack of Chaos Force. This attack does not activate passive skills of the enemies.
